_purpose: Gate 4N-I28BH-E2. A CLOSED, authored allow-list of AMBIENT environment variables that the runner/OS/toolchain provides and that Gate-4N guard consumers read DEFENSIVELY (os.environ.get(VAR, default)). ci_env_dataflow consults this list ONLY on the 'no workflow producer' branch: an ambient var legitimately has no ci.yml producer because the runner supplies it. A variable that a workflow step PRODUCES (job/step env or a $GITHUB_ENV write) is handled by the ordering rule and must NEVER appear here — ci_env_dataflow asserts that disjointness and fails closed if it is violated, so this list cannot launder a real ordering defect. Every entry names its provider and the defensive read site.
_rule: Consulted only when producer is None. allow_list must be disjoint from every step's github_env_writes and step_env. Unknown-and-unlisted still fails closed.

RUNNER_TEMP.read_site: root_wiring_check.py:main os.environ.get("RUNNER_TEMP") with a tempfile.gettempdir() fallback — selects only WHERE the disposable work directory is created (never inside the repository), so an absent value is safe
